description: Round 7's fix for FIND-012 is incomplete: it added exactly the ONE omitted test file the finding happened to name by example (`spawn-orchestrator-reclaim-and-shelter-cost.test.mjs`), but contracts/sprint-2.md's 'Files touched' section (lines 108-126, explicitly self-described at line 108 as 'final list as delivered through Phase 2c (refactor)') still omits TWO OTHER test files that are genuinely delivered this sprint and directly test `spawn-orchestrator.mjs`: `skills/self/spawn/lib/__tests__/spawn-orchestrator-funding-and-wallet.test.mjs` and `skills/self/spawn/lib/__tests__/spawn-orchestrator-gas-seed-and-key-persistence.test.mjs`. Both are confirmed present on disk (8.0K and 15.5K respectively) and both are confirmed, by direct read of their own header comments, to be sprint-2 contract-review-fix deliverables for THIS module: `spawn-orchestrator-funding-and-wallet.test.mjs`'s own header reads 'VCSDD anicca-agent-spawn, sprint-2, contract-review round 2 (resolves FIND-001/002/003a)' and it imports `defaultDeploy, assertRealEvmAddress, shelterCostUsdFromSettledPrice` directly from `../spawn-orchestrator.mjs`; `spawn-orchestrator-gas-seed-and-key-persistence.test.mjs`'s own header reads 'VCSDD anicca-agent-spawn, sprint-2, contract-review round 3 (resolves FIND-006/FIND-007a/FIND-007b)' and it imports from `../spawn-orchestrator.mjs` (confirmed at its own line 26) the `defaultPersistChildWallet`/`defaultSeedChild` functions the contract's own 'Round 2 additions' prose (sprint-2.md:128-140) discusses under the SAME round-2/round-3 fix cycles. Neither file is a false positive: both are confirmed, by git history, first-committed on 2026-07-08 at 14:04:14 (`spawn-orchestrator-funding-and-wallet.test.mjs`, commit f3419d3) and 14:37:14 (`spawn-orchestrator-gas-seed-and-key-persistence.test.mjs`, commit 31e36c9) respectively -- both AFTER `spawn-orchestrator.mjs` itself (first committed 05:51:51, commit 75a43e8) and both explicitly tied to this sprint's own contract-review fix rounds, not a different sprint or a pre-existing file. This is the EXACT SAME class of gap FIND-012 itself named ('the contract's own "Files touched" section... omitted' a genuinely-delivered test file) -- round 7's fix only closed the ONE instance FIND-012 happened to cite as its concrete example, without sweeping the section for the other files with the identical defect. A third file, `spawn-gap-coverage.test.mjs`, was also checked and is correctly OUT of scope for this list: it is confirmed, by git history (first committed 2026-07-08 04:09:47, BEFORE `spawn-orchestrator.mjs` existed at 05:51:51) and by direct read of its own header ('VCSDD anicca-agent-spawn, Phase 5 (Formal Hardening)') and imports (`treasury-gate.mjs`, `colony-balances.mjs`, `child-spec.js`, `resolve-identity.mjs` -- never `spawn-orchestrator.mjs`), to be a sprint-1 Phase-5 deliverable unrelated to this module, so its absence from this list is correct, not a gap.
